metadata.description: The APXY Claude Code plugin. It adds the APXY MCP server and a skill that verifies code changes against the real HTTP requests they send.

plugins.name: apxy
plugins.description: Verify code changes against the real HTTP requests they send. Run the code through the APXY proxy, wait for the request, assert on it, and read pass or fail from the exit code. Also inspects, mocks, and replays HTTP and HTTPS traffic.
